root_cause: The only original victory chain was a SmartAI health poll at 0..8 percent. Mephistroth had no lethal-damage protection and could die in one hit before any such poll, matching the user's missing defeat credit. There is no on-death fallback. Independently, the original chain required successful cast 152821 before reaching credit, skull summon and despawn. Native SMART_ACTION_CAST returns before LINK when every cast fails. Credit targeted ACTION_INVOKER, which can be a pet or absent during a timed health poll; action 205 only credits Player targets. These are executable failure paths; the exact last damaging spell from the reported client attempt was not captured.
